reports.title: Statistics Ordinance (New Version), 5732-1972
reports.publisher: State of Israel (Central Bureau of Statistics operates under this law)
reports.description: Foundational legal instrument establishing the Central Bureau of Statistics, defining its mandate to collect and publish statistics on population, society, economy and other domains, the public’s obligation to provide information, and the CBS obligation of confidentiality and publication.

reports.title: Statistical Abstract of Israel
reports.description: Annual comprehensive reference publication presenting data on approximately 28 demographic, economic and social topics, including multi-year trends and international comparisons. Includes the summary booklet ‘Israel in Figures’.

reports.title: Monthly Bulletin of Statistics
reports.description: Monthly compilation presenting current data across climate, population, health, tourism, immigration, national accounts, balance of payments, foreign trade, prices, labour market, agriculture, manufacturing, business, transport and crime/justice.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index measuring changes in the prices of a fixed basket of goods and services representing household consumption. Primary inflation indicator.

reports.title: National Accounts and Gross Domestic Product
reports.description: Quarterly and annual estimates of Gross Domestic Product and related national-accounts aggregates (production, expenditure and income approaches).

reports.title: Labour Force Survey and Labour Market Indicators
reports.description: Monthly and quarterly labour-force statistics including unemployment rate, employment, labour-force participation, job vacancies and related indicators derived primarily from the Labour Force Survey.

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.publisher: Central Bureau of Statistics / Bank of Israel
reports.description: Quarterly and annual Balance of Payments statistics covering the current account, capital account and financial account, reflecting transactions between Israeli residents and non-residents.

reports.title: Foreign Trade Statistics (Goods)
reports.description: Monthly statistics on imports and exports of goods, trade balance, trade by country, and related price/volume/terms-of-trade indices. Separate media releases cover overall trade and trade by country.

reports.title: Population Estimates and Demographic Indicators
reports.description: Regular population estimates (total, by population group, age, sex) together with births, deaths, immigration, emigration and related demographic indicators. Updated periodically and highlighted around Independence Day and major holidays.

reports.title: Dwellings Price Index
reports.description: Monthly quality-adjusted price index of dwellings (new and second-hand), based on transaction prices. Includes regional breakdowns and separate tracking of new dwellings and government-supported transactions.

reports.title: Foreign Exchange Reserves at the Bank of Israel
reports.description: Monthly statement of Israel’s foreign-exchange reserves held by the Bank of Israel, including level, change, and ratio to GDP. Published as a regular press release.

reports.title: Producer Price Indices (Manufacturing and Services)
reports.description: Monthly Producer Price Index for manufacturing output destined for the domestic market, together with related indices for manufacturing exports and Services Producer Price Indices (SPPI). Published as part of the Price Statistics Monthly suite.

reports.title: Industrial Production Index
reports.description: Monthly index of industrial production covering mining and manufacturing (excluding diamonds in some series). Seasonally adjusted and unadjusted series are published.

reports.title: Business Tendency Survey
reports.description: Monthly survey of business managers on current economic situation, recent performance and short-term expectations (sales, employment, etc.). Results are published as net balances by industry.

reports.title: Tourism and Visitor Arrivals Statistics
reports.description: Monthly and quarterly statistics on visitor arrivals (tourists and day visitors), hotel overnight stays (Israelis and tourists), room occupancy and related tourism indicators.

reports.title: Average Gross Wages per Employee Job
reports.description: Monthly statistics on average gross wages per employee job (current and constant prices), number of employee jobs, and related employment-and-wages series. Based primarily on National Insurance Institute employer reports.

reports.title: Building Starts and Completions
reports.description: Quarterly and annual statistics on residential and non-residential building starts, completions, building permits, and related construction-activity indicators (including duration of construction).

reports.title: Monetary Aggregates (Bank of Israel)
reports.description: Regular statistics on the monetary base, money supply (M1 and broader aggregates), and related monetary indicators compiled by the Bank of Israel.

reports.title: Bank of Israel Statistical Bulletin
reports.description: Annual Statistical Bulletin presenting main financial aggregates (public’s financial assets portfolio, private-sector debt, economic activity vis-à-vis abroad, foreign-exchange activity of main sectors) together with methodological papers.

reports.title: Household Expenditure Survey
reports.description: Annual survey collecting detailed data on household income (from all sources), consumption expenditure, ownership of durables and related living-standards indicators. Results feed CPI basket updates and national-accounts private consumption.

reports.title: Poverty and Income Inequality Report
reports.description: Annual report on the dimensions of poverty and income inequality in Israel, based primarily on administrative data held by the National Insurance Institute (with supplementary estimates). Includes poverty rates, Gini, and related social indicators.

reports.title: State Budget Execution (Estimated)
reports.description: Monthly estimated execution of the state budget, covering revenues (especially tax), expenditures, and the resulting deficit/surplus. Published by the Macroeconomic and Budget Division of the Accountant General’s Office.

reports.title: International Investment Position (IIP)
reports.publisher: Bank of Israel / Central Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Quarterly International Investment Position showing the composition of Israel’s financial assets and liabilities vis-à-vis the rest of the world (direct investment, portfolio investment, other investment). Includes net IIP and changes due to transactions, prices and exchange rates.

reports.title: External Debt Statistics
reports.description: Quarterly gross and net external debt statistics, broken down by sector (public, banking, non-bank private), maturity, and instrument. Includes debt-service indicators and ratios to GDP.

reports.title: Foreign Direct Investment Statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Israel / Central Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Statistics on inward and outward foreign direct investment flows and stocks, including by economic branch and partner country. Regularly analysed in Bank of Israel Statistical Bulletin methodological papers and external-sector releases.

reports.title: Foreign Workers and Non-Israeli Labour Statistics
reports.publisher: Population and Immigration Authority / Central Bureau of Statistics / Bank of Israel
reports.description: Recurring statistics on legal and illegal foreign workers by sector (construction, agriculture, nursing, etc.), quotas, and related non-Israeli labour (including historical series on Palestinian workers employed in Israel). Published in quarterly Population and Immigration Authority reports and referenced in CBS and Bank of Israel labour-market analysis.

reports.title: Financial Stability Report
reports.description: Semi-annual (moving toward annual) assessment of the financial system’s exposure to major risks, analysis of those exposures, and evaluation of potential risk scenarios. Covers banking system resilience, credit risk, asset-price channels, and institutional solvency.

reports.title: Public’s Financial Assets Portfolio
reports.description: Regular statistics on the composition and value of the public’s financial assets portfolio (cash and deposits, equities, bonds, mutual funds, institutional-investor assets, etc.). Published quarterly and summarised annually in the Statistical Bulletin.

reports.title: Nonfinancial Private Sector Debt
reports.description: Statistics on the outstanding debt of the nonfinancial private sector (business sector and households), including breakdowns by housing/non-housing credit, industry, and source of credit. Regularly published and analysed in the Statistical Bulletin and financial-stability work.

dependencies.basis: The Statistical Abstract of Israel is produced and published by the Central Bureau of Statistics under the authority and mandate established by the Statistics Ordinance (New Version), 5732-1972.
The Monthly Bulletin of Statistics is a core recurring publication of the Central Bureau of Statistics operating under the Statistics Ordinance.
National-accounts aggregates appear as a regular section within the Monthly Bulletin of Statistics and are released on the CBS main-indicators page.
CPI data form a standard prices section of the Monthly Bulletin of Statistics and are highlighted among the CBS main indicators.
Monthly goods trade data feed into the goods component of the quarterly Balance of Payments; full goods-and-services aggregates appear in the BOP while the monthly series focus on goods.
Population estimates and demographic indicators form a core chapter of the annual Statistical Abstract of Israel and appear among the CBS main indicators.

The Dwellings Price Index is a specialised housing-market price series published by the same prices division that produces the Consumer Price Index; both are part of the broader CBS price-statistics programme.
Foreign-exchange reserves are a key stock counterpart to the financial-account flows recorded in the Balance of Payments and are regularly referenced in external-sector analysis.
Producer price indices for manufacturing output are used in the deflation of current-price industrial production series to obtain volume measures of the Industrial Production Index.
Business Tendency Survey results appear among the forward-looking indicators regularly referenced alongside hard data in CBS publications and the Monthly Bulletin framework.
Tourism and accommodation services form a regular section of the Monthly Bulletin of Statistics; detailed visitor-arrival and hotel series are released monthly and quarterly.
Industrial production volume measures contribute to the production-side estimates of GDP and appear among the short-term activity indicators used in national-accounts compilation.
Average wage series complement the Labour Force Survey employment and unemployment indicators; both form core labour-market statistics published by CBS and appear among the main indicators.
Building starts and completions are supply-side counterparts to the Dwellings Price Index and are regularly analysed together in housing-market assessments.
Monetary aggregates and foreign-exchange reserves are both core Bank of Israel statistical products used in monetary-policy analysis and external-sector monitoring.
The Statistical Bulletin includes a section on economic activity vis-à-vis abroad that draws on and presents Balance of Payments and related external-sector aggregates.
Results of the Household Expenditure Survey are used to update the CPI consumption basket and weights on a regular multi-year cycle.
Household expenditure data from the survey are integrated into the private-consumption component of the national accounts.
The poverty and inequality report draws on administrative income data and is informed by household survey concepts; earlier NII reports relied more heavily on the Household Expenditure Survey itself.
Budget-execution deficit figures are routinely expressed as a percentage of GDP and are a key fiscal indicator used alongside national-accounts aggregates.
The International Investment Position is the stock counterpart to the financial-account flows recorded in the Balance of Payments; both are compiled under the same BPM framework.
External debt statistics form the debt-instrument component of the International Investment Position liabilities and are published alongside IIP aggregates.

Foreign direct investment stocks and flows are a primary component of the International Investment Position and are analysed in detail in Bank of Israel external-sector and Statistical Bulletin publications.

Non-Israeli and foreign-worker counts are regularly referenced alongside Israeli Labour Force Survey employment aggregates in Bank of Israel and CBS labour-market analysis to explain total labour supply.
The Financial Stability Report draws on monetary aggregates, credit developments and institutional balance-sheet data compiled by the Bank of Israel.
Private-sector debt aggregates and credit-quality indicators are central inputs to the risk analysis contained in the Financial Stability Report.
